summary: Adopt verified serial autonomy in fresh project onboarding
description: Source-maintenance follow-up to go-workflow-stack autonomy-01 through autonomy-09. Planning only. Pin the released proven stack and expose bounded goal, vision/architecture relevance, outcome evidence and night-run setup without user-specific defaults. See .go/plans/autonomy-first.json.
acceptance: Wait for the stack live-proof task and exact released stack ref with verified receipt; do not introduce new consumer behavior by merely updating a pin.

A fresh disposable clone explicitly chooses goal, models, cumulative budget and release/deployment authority, then can follow exploration-to-delivery through repo-local state. Default remains serial; unknown product choices remain unknown.

Starter vision and architecture explain actual product outcomes, conditional decisions and matching proof without mandatory bureaucracy. No maintenance queue, source model/account or private pilot evidence leaks into published starter payload.

Prove fresh-clone onboarding, refusal before missing authority, multi-task continuation and compatible serial smoke with local checks. Keep source project_mode template and reusable task-schema-smoke.

Complete scoped commit/push and immutable source release/readback; preserve canonical maintenance records until closure and archive them outside the runnable starter queue before distributing the starter. No GitHub Actions.
